title: Wife's wedding ring moved and found by prayer

tellings.quote: So, her wedding ring was actually moved.

plain: In 2024, at their home, the wedding ring of a woman named Kristen Fugal is said to have been moved from where she left it, and then found through prayer. Her husband Brandon Fugal, the owner of a Utah ranch known for strange reports, tells it, relaying what Kristen experienced. He tells it as one of the odd happenings that he says reach beyond the ranch.
